  "decision": "fail",

  "summary": "This headmotion1 acquisition shows a mutually reinforcing pattern of provenance-confirmed large rotation, elevated spatial blurring, and degraded SNR consistent with significant head motion artifact.",
  "flagged_metrics": [
    "large_rot_frame",
    "fwhm_avg",

    "Provenance warning `large_rot_frame=true` confirms at least one frame with a large rotation event, directly indicating head motion during acquisition.",
    "fwhm_avg=4.677, percentile=95.96 — spatial blurring is at the extreme high end of the reference population, consistent with motion-induced blurring across the volume.",
    "fwhm_y=4.874, percentile=90.28 — directional blurring in the y-axis is also elevated, reinforcing a motion-related blurring pattern.",
    "snr_gm=13.45, percentile=33.70 and snr_wm=20.70, percentile=26.91 — tissue-specific SNR is below average across both gray and white matter, consistent with motion-degraded signal quality (high-evidence metrics).",
    "snr_total=12.52, percentile=32.07 — overall SNR is below average, corroborating tissue-level SNR degradation in the context of confirmed motion.",
    "tpm_overlap across all three tissue classes is at very low percentiles (CSF=1.48, GM=3.14, WM=4.52), suggesting poor tissue segmentation consistency likely driven by motion-distorted anatomy rather than registration error alone."
  ],
  "recommended_followup": [
    "Visually inspect the scan for ringing/ghosting artifacts, particularly in the phase-encode direction, to confirm motion artifact morphology.",
    "Review snrd_gm=120.12 (percentile=99.28) and snrd_wm=163.68 (percentile=99.47) — these unusually high values relative to background air may reflect a compressed or atypical background mask and should be verified.",
    "Check summary_bg_mean=7.02 (percentile=4.54) and summary_bg_stdv=7.26 (percentile=3.35) — low background statistics may indicate an unusual background region and could affect qi_1/qi_2 interpretation.",
    "Consider whether this scan can be excluded or re-acquired given the confirmed large rotation frame and the acquisition label indicating intentional motion (headmotion1)."
  ]
}
